projection_contract.purpose: Recap chips should resolve to global-style graph nodes with focus-session evidence and prep-useful adjacency.
projection_contract.focus_session_policy: Session 24 evidence is highlighted, but nodes should remain global-style identities where possible.

nodes.label: Questionable Company
nodes.session_focus_summary: The party finishes the immediate north-gate battle, then splits between wall watch/short rest and town/refugee planning.

nodes.label: Session 24 Mireward north-gate battle
nodes.session_focus_summary: The north-gate battle continues from the prior cliffhanger and ends when Thrin finishes the final tripod, but the broader crisis remains unresolved.

nodes.label: Karsemine
nodes.session_focus_summary: Karsemine uses fire against tripods, reveals golem traits with Hunter's Mark, kills a sewer monster with a poison-spray consequence, accidentally hits Ephanna, then kills the final hybrid.

nodes.label: Ephanna
nodes.session_focus_summary: Ephanna is compelled by meatwings, climbs down the wall, destroys a hybrid, damages the golem, is impaled and pulled by a tripod, takes necrotic damage, is accidentally shot by Karsemine, joins the final assault, then stays at the wall for short rest/watch.

nodes.label: Bonogo
nodes.session_focus_summary: Bonogo is compelled by meatwings, pins a hybrid, kills a meatwing, trips/damages the golem, kills a sewer monster through Baergrom's Commander’s Strike, then opens the coordinated final assault.

nodes.label: Baergrom
nodes.session_focus_summary: Baergrom's crossbow jams, he switches to a short bow, later uses Bait and Switch to move Thrin, uses Commander’s Strike to direct Bonogo, is hit by poison spray, and remains at the wall for watch/short rest.

nodes.label: Caelynn
nodes.session_focus_summary: Caelynn is charmed, is cleansed by Lysandra, uses Magic Missile against meatwings, joins the final tripod attack, and calls Grobnok to report Edge and Mireward Reach.

nodes.label: Stafl
nodes.session_focus_summary: Stafl gives Bardic Inspiration, attempts Enemies Abound on the golem, uses Sleep and Luck against the tripod, then remains at the wall for watch/short rest.

nodes.label: Thrin
nodes.session_focus_summary: Thrin panics early, is moved out of danger by Baergrom, contributes to the golem collapse, and finishes the final tripod.

nodes.label: Lysandra Ironveil
nodes.session_focus_summary: Lysandra directs attacks with Commanding Shout, removes Caelynn's charm, pushes the final assault, and is the intended target of a pending Grobnok rockie-talkie bridge.

nodes.label: Ogonob
nodes.session_focus_summary: Ogonob is attacked by hybrid and tripod monsters, Misty Steps toward a tripod, kills a meatwing, is threatened by a sewer monster, and joins the final coordinated attack.

nodes.label: Grobnok
nodes.session_focus_summary: Grobnok receives Caelynn's report about Edge and Mireward Reach, is frustrated by not being able to act, and says he will call back the next day while a rockie-talkie bridge to Lysandra remains pending.

nodes.label: Edge refugees
nodes.session_focus_summary: The refugees from Edge still need a plan after the battle; screening, housing, admission, safety, and contamination status remain unresolved.

nodes.label: Wall watch/rest team
nodes.session_focus_summary: Ephanna, Stafl, and Baergrom stay at the wall above the gate to stand watch while taking a short rest.

nodes.label: Town/refugee planning team
aliases: others will go check on the town
create a plan for the refugees
nodes.session_focus_summary: The rest of the group goes to check on Mireward Reach and create a plan for the Edge refugees; exact member list is implicit rather than enumerated.

nodes.label: Mireward Reach
nodes.session_focus_summary: Mireward Reach survives the immediate battle but remains under crisis pressure from refugees, wall damage, nightfall, and communications needs.

nodes.label: Edge
nodes.session_focus_summary: Edge remains the refugee origin and a reported crisis site; its current status is unresolved in Session 24.

nodes.label: North gate
nodes.session_focus_summary: The north gate/wall above the gate is the post-battle watch and short-rest position.

nodes.label: North wall
nodes.session_focus_summary: The wall/foundation is attacked by a hybrid and threatened by the golem; a sewer monster climbs onto the wall and creates a sticky gel hazard. Structural safety is unresolved.

nodes.label: Battlefield outside the gate
nodes.session_focus_summary: The post-battle field contains meat piles that turn to goo and sink underground when the party tries to burn them.

nodes.label: Tripod meat monsters
nodes.session_focus_summary: Tripods have ignitable gases/flesh, can launch impaling spikes that pull targets, can be affected by Sleep, and are eliminated by the end of the immediate battle.

nodes.label: Flying meatwings
nodes.session_focus_summary: Meatwings compel targets to move toward and consume monsters while preventing direct attacks; one sacrifices itself to wake a sleeping tripod.

nodes.label: Hybrid monsters
nodes.session_focus_summary: Hybrid monsters attack Ogonob and Ephanna, deal necrotic damage, can chip at the wall foundation, and are destroyed during the battle.

nodes.label: Golem-like creature
nodes.session_focus_summary: The golem ignores Enemies Abound, dashes to the wall to break it down, is immune to poison and charm, weak to fire, gets knocked prone, and collapses after team damage.

nodes.label: Giant sewer monsters
nodes.session_focus_summary: Sewer monsters split up, climb the wall, ooze sticky gel that makes escape difficult, and can spray poison on death.

nodes.label: Meat piles / goo sinking into ground
nodes.session_focus_summary: When the party tries to burn remaining meat piles, the piles turn to goo and sink underground. This is unresolved and should not be treated as destroyed or purified.

nodes.label: North wall/foundation damage
nodes.session_focus_summary: The wall/foundation has been attacked and must not be assumed safe, breached, collapsed, or repaired without later evidence.

nodes.label: Refugee handling plan
aliases: something needs to be done with the refugees
nodes.session_focus_summary: The group needs to decide what to do with the Edge refugees; the recap ends before the plan is made.

nodes.label: Short rest and wall watch
nodes.session_focus_summary: Ephanna, Stafl, and Baergrom stay at the wall above the gate to stand watch while short resting and recovering.

nodes.label: Grobnok next-day callback
aliases: call them back the next day
nodes.session_focus_summary: Grobnok says he will call the party back the next day.

nodes.label: Grobnok-Lysandra rockie-talkie link
nodes.session_focus_summary: Caelynn attempts to connect Grobnok's rockie-talkie with Lysandra’s, but this will take time and is not complete in the source.

nodes.label: Edge status after siege
nodes.session_focus_summary: Edge remains important and unresolved; do not claim Edge is saved, destroyed, empty, or fully occupied.

nodes.label: Fire/gas ignition vulnerability
nodes.session_focus_summary: Karsemine's Firebolt ignites tripod gases/flesh, dealing massive damage and later killing one tripod.

nodes.label: Immune to poison and charm
nodes.session_focus_summary: Karsemine's Hunter's Mark reveals the golem is immune to poison and charm.

nodes.label: Weak to fire
nodes.session_focus_summary: Karsemine's Hunter's Mark reveals the golem is weak to fire.

nodes.label: Sticky gel hazard
nodes.session_focus_summary: The giant sewer monsters ooze sticky gel that makes it difficult to move away from them.
